query:
SELECT framework, channel, COUNT(*) as sent, SUM(gotReply) as replies,
  ROUND(SUM(gotReply)/COUNT(*)*100,1) as reply_pct
FROM message_outcomes 
WHERE createdAt >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 MONTH) AND framework IS NOT NULL AND channel IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY framework, channel HAVING sent >= 10 ORDER BY reply_pct DESC LIMIT 20;
